resources.name: VertexSpecification
resources.description:
A Vertex is connected by directed Edges to other vertices in a Graph.
A VertexSpecification is a base class that represents a generic means for implementing a particular type of Vertex. In essence, a VertexSpecification defines the common attributes and relationships of a set of related Vertices, while Vertex defines a specific instance that is based on a particular VertexSpecification.

fields.name: configurable
fields.description: If true, the Boolean indicates that the target Characteristic is configurable

fields.name: description
fields.description: A narrative that explains the CharacteristicSpecification.

fields.name: extensible
fields.description: An indicator that specifies that the values for the characteristic can be extended by adding new values when instantiating a characteristic for a resource.

fields.name: isUnique
fields.description: Specifies if the value of this characteristic is unique across all entities instantiated from the specification that uses this characteristc. For example, consider a ProductSpecification for a set-top box, with a CharacteristicSpecification cardID. Each set-top box must have a different value for cardID, so this isUnique attribute would be set to true for the characteristic.

fields.name: maxCardinality
fields.description: The maximum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on. For example, zero to five phone numbers in a group calling plan, where five is the value for the maxCardinality.

fields.name: minCardinality
fields.description: The minimum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on. For example, zero to five phone numbers in a group calling plan, where zero is the value for the minCardinality.

fields.name: name
fields.description: A word, term, or phrase by which this characteristic specification is known and distinguished from other characteristic specifications.

fields.name: regex
fields.description: A rule or principle represented in regular JsonLdExpression used to derive the value of a characteristic value.

fields.name: valueType
fields.description: A kind of value that the characteristic can take on, such as numeric, text and so forth

fields.name: atValueSchemaLocation
fields.description: This (optional) field provides a link to the schema describing the value type.

flattenedRefs.name: validFor
flattenedRefs.description: The period of time for which a characteristic is applicable.

fields.name: isDefault
fields.description: If true, the Boolean Indicates if the value is the default value for a characteristic

fields.name: rangeInterval
fields.description: An indicator that specifies the inclusion or exclusion of the valueFrom and valueTo attributes. If applicable, possible values are "open", "closed", "closedBottom" and "closedTop".

fields.name: regex
fields.description: A regular JsonLdExpression constraint for given value

fields.name: unitOfMeasure
fields.description: A length, surface, volume, dry measure, liquid measure, money, weight, time, and the like. In general, a determinate quantity or magnitude of the kind designated, taken as a standard of comparison for others of the same kind, in assigning to them numerical values, as 1 foot, 1 yard, 1 mile, 1 square foot.

fields.name: valueFrom
fields.description: The low range value that a characteristic can take on

fields.name: valueTo
fields.description: The upper range value that a characteristic can take on

fields.name: valueType
fields.description: A kind of value that the characteristic value can take on, such as numeric, text and so forth

flattenedRefs.description: The period of time for which a value is applicable.
